_comment: Canonical library of Category Blitz categories. Each must pass BOTH gates in CATEGORY_TEST.md (Is-A + Letter-Coverage). Add categories here; then run `npm run category-blitz:build` to resolve each category's abundant letters and rebuild data/category-blitz/category-letter-index.json (the letter-first index the game draws boards from).
